Authenticity 0.3.2.

- **Review fix: underline styles without the partially supported text-decoration features.** The few underlines in the panes (the wavy and dotted examples in the AI characters list, and the dotted labels of the Plagiarism pane's thresholds) are now drawn with a border and a background instead of styled text decorations. They look the same in light and dark themes. The underlines in your notes are unchanged.

Nothing else changed. The helper program and the other native programs are unchanged: keep using the ones from the [native release 0.3.0](https://github.com/Gameboard-dev/authenticity/releases/tag/native-0.3.0).

The plugin's files are `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css`, built by GitHub Actions from this tag and attested: `gh attestation verify main.js --repo Gameboard-dev/authenticity`.
